recomputed: The five ledgers show a checksum-matched processed source, a prior not_located/not_tested decision, and no comparability record, additional comparison spec or concordance review for this dataset. The registry specifies pvn / stress_vs_control. All 46 SOURCES.tsv hashes and byte lengths match (5,400,562 bytes), as do the seven local input pins in comparison.json. I decoded both JPEGs, read all gzip members to EOF, parsed the structured responses and distinguished ten service errors or browser barriers from the 36 successful responses. Fresh GEO copies of both the FPKM matrix and family SOFT match the registered source pins. The journal image, caption and Results show five upregulated labels in panel A. Panel B is the minocycline comparison. The sample sheet matches five model and five untreated male rat PVN libraries, with five minocycline-plus-stress libraries excluded. All 15 GSMs declare no sample supplements. The FPKM file contains 24,160 feature rows, 15 sample columns and three annotation columns. The GEO series matrix has zero expression rows. Applying the registered transformation, feature map, aggregation and variance filter to the deposit yielded 22,355 tested rows and reproduced the 16,117 published stress-minus-control coefficients to a maximum absolute difference of 4.45e-14. Registered coefficients, rounded to six decimals, were Fgf2 +0.607288, Hmgb2 +0.694923, Hif3a +1.001892, Apoc1 +0.847144 and Clec7a +0.300234. All 5/5 named rows had raw P < 0.05, 4/5 met the combined rule and 0/5 had BH FDR < 0.05. Clec7a’s exact registered logFC, raw P and FDR were 0.30023372056396, 0.0207417795996929 and 0.337781286455566. The local DE table and restored track both gave 70 up and 123 down at raw P < 0.05 with either absolute log2FC ≥ 0.5 or > 0.5. Eight of 16,117 published rows had FDR < 0.05. The paper reports 211 up and 292 down. Coverage is 5/5 caption labels, 5/503 reported DEGs and 5/16,117 published registered genes, with zero exact author logFC, P or FDR pairs. The set and orientation come from the paper and include every label. All ten original computed entries reproduce within their stated gene-symbol scope. The compared closure applies to these five directions and their screen membership. The 30-pair minimum is unmet and the full sign-off list is empty.
problems: The proposed method_differences outcome gives the different estimators more explanatory weight than the data support. Clec7a changes screen membership and the two aggregate totals differ. The public sources do not identify the cause. The corrected proposal uses review_required and unresolved while retaining the completed comparison.

The proposal identifies the Hmgb2 ambiguity but omits its effect on direction. ENSRNOG00000013167 maps to Hmgb2 (+0.694923, raw P 0.002740), while ENSRNOG00000033321 maps to Hmgb2l1 (−0.048282, raw P 0.834118). Five same-symbol signs agree. Feature-level agreement for the fifth point depends on an author identifier or aggregation that the figure does not give.

The accessions and arm assignments establish a match for the sequenced groups. The manuscript and deposit do not identify individual animals independently of their library labels. The corrected cohort note limits the identity claim accordingly.
